title: Monster Hunter Generations Ultimate: online side built for OpenPak
body: Monster Hunter Generations Ultimate has its online side implemented on OpenPak, so the network service the game expects is now something we serve. It has not yet been tested on a real console, so treat the online hunts as unproven for now. We will report here once a console has played online through OpenPak.
footer: OpenPak Monster Hunter Generations Ultimate — playable, not promised.
